first.note: the curve runs into the left frame (x = 0 line; frame ink u 780 to 790, centre 785.0): sample at the frame's inner edge, u bound reaching the frame centre; no ink left of the frame

last.note: the curve runs into the right frame (x = 1.0 line; frame ink u 2328 to 2337, centre 2332.6): sample at the frame's inner edge; no ink beyond the frame; above the y = 50 line, the highest labelled line, so y is extrapolated from the 45 to 50 interval

features.note: toe of the S-shaped curve, a gradual bend, not a kink: straight stretches dv/du -0.276 (u 791 to 900) and -0.524 (u 1230 to 1430), a 47 % change, curvature spread evenly over u 850 to 1210; knee at the curvature-weighted centroid of the bend between them (u 1052, Dr 0.17); u bound 80 px (about 0.05 in Dr), v bound = |slope| x 80 px + half the line thickness

shoulder, a gradual bend: straight stretches dv/du -0.572 (u 1600 to 2020) and -0.417 (u 2250 to 2327), a 27 % change; knee at the curvature-weighted centroid of the bend between them (u 2157, Dr 0.87; curvature peak at u 2235), on clean ink just left of a print crack at u 2179 to 2200; above the y = 50 line, so y is extrapolated from the 45 to 50 interval; u bound 80 px, v bound = |slope| x 80 px + half the line thickness
